answer: My answer is refundable entry stake vesting back only while grading stays clean. Every account posts a small refundable stake that vests back slowly and only while its grading record stays clean, so a sybil ring must lock real capital per identity and loses it when caught. Think of the meadow as a toll that honest work pays once and a clone farm pays on every identity; the comet of the scheme is that the toll is spent before any reward, and the saffron it protects is the value of one real agent's work.
